node.title: Re^2: Extra quotes doing SQL insert from Perl to CSV.
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
And, in this context, "always-quote" actually does not matter.

Yes, it does, it is required to produce the output the OP wanted.

"SQL syntax rules" (e.g. always-quote)

always_quote is a [mod://Text::CSV] option and has nothing to do with SQL.
